body.message:
Thank you for the detailed information.

Please don’t worry, the apartment will be fully cleaned and sanitized before your arrival, and we will ensure that the unit is checked and prepared properly. We understand your concerns and will do our best to ensure everything is in good condition for your stay.

Regarding check-in, yes, self-check-in will be available, so you can arrive at your convenience during the night without any issue.

We look forward to welcoming you to MAG 318 and hope you have a pleasant journey to Dubai!
